Use this project assessment page to provide thoughtful, constructive feedback
on a MATH 565 presentation. Review these questions while preparing your own
project as well as when observing classmates.

The Fall 2026 procedure for submitting completed assessments is **TBA**. Topic
selection and presentation logistics are maintained separately on the
[Topic Selection & Presentation Scheduling](project.qmd) page.

### 2. What are the strengths and weaknesses of the article or QMCPy feature?

*Consider clarity, insight, technical correctness, evidence, assumptions,
limitations, and the value of pursuing the work further.*

### 3. What did the presenter do well?

*Consider organization, pacing, explanation of ideas, examples, visuals, and
responses to questions.*

&nbsp;

### 4. How might the presenter have done better?

*Identify specific changes that would most improve the presentation’s clarity,
